cover.coreProposition: A durable snapshot may be authoritative enough to reconstruct context without being authoritative enough to authorize action; resumable Agent runtimes should keep reconstruction evidence, lineage and freshness identity, and current execution authorization separately inspectable, revalidating permission-bearing restored state before it can shape capabilities or effects.
cover.visualMetaphor: A sealed archive capsule passes through a separate illuminated permission gate
cover.semanticObject: A durable state capsule, a lineage marker and an independent access gate
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with two clearly separated stages: continuity recovery and present-time authorization
